The supplied changes are documentation only: CHANGELOG.md head excerpts (lines 1018-1795) and a docs/README.md patch (hunk @@ -93,6 +93,8, +2 lines) that links a new page, provider/cache-storage.md, described as "set cache write limits and choose a suitable external disk". No executable code, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or routing logic changed in the supplied text, so there are no concrete findings. The new target page, docs/provider/cache-storage.md, was not supplied. Unit 07b0937cb45ba711:0 is metadata-only with no text. Coverage limits:
- T-041/TB-007: the encrypted SSD prefix cache (HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute sliding TTL, default budget of half the available disk with no fixed ceiling, 20 GiB pre-write reserve, KEK-wipe purge) is the relevant boundary. If the new page or an unseen code change lets the cache root sit on an external or removable disk, the at-rest posture needs review. It would affect the disk-budget and reserve semantics, the KEK-wipe purge reach, and the residual metadata (file count, sizes, mtimes), which T-041 assumes stay on the internal data volume.
- CHANGELOG.md line 1128 says the default shared SSD cache ceiling is "100 GiB, limited to half the volume's currently available space". The T-041 text says there is no fixed ceiling. This is probably an older entry in unchanged context, and the diff was not visible, so I do not claim drift. The next pass should confirm which statement matches SSDPrefixCachePolicy / PrefixCachePolicy.ssdDiskBudgetBytes and whether the cache-storage page restates either one.
- The changelog's mentions of Stripe Global Payouts and payout reconciliation (lines 1026-1029, TB-008/T-060), the HF model-download SHA-256 fallback (line 1039, TB-007/T-027) and the profiler tables (T-051) are prose only, with no code in this batch.
